answer: Mechanism: Coordination Component Tariff (CCT). At each dawn, agents open coordination channels through a public haven; each channel receives a VDF-derived canyon segment ID for the epoch. Channel rent scales with distinct endpoints and message occupancy; actions are valid only with a matching channel receipt. To run N sybils as independent actors, an attacker must rent separate channels, paying N rents plus VDF latency per partition; if they share one channel, endpoint and segment linkage collapses the pseudonyms into one auditable coalition.
